description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Switch Draw Mode II (Ice, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode I: Edea v2] and [(Ice/Dark) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode I: Edea v2
